messages:
Deepti (People Ops): @here Quick update on the Q2 West Coast Retreat (Portland) — travel, lodging, and accessibility info. Dates are Jun 14-16. Please skim and RSVP by May 20.

Ava (People Ops): Hotel block reserved at The Alder (downtown) — link: <https://intranet.redwood.com/onsite/portland-housing>. Shuttle scheduled to the venue Mon/Tue 7:30am & 8:30am. :bus:

Jonas (Eng): Are we covering hotels for folks traveling >2hrs?

Carlos (Finance): New travel subsidy for retreats: domestic up to $600, international up to $1200. Meals covered per diem $60/day if not on the company tab. Reimburse via Expensify and tag expenses with onsite code.

Carlos (Finance): ```expense tag: onsite-2026 
Notes: include conference badge + receipts. 
Policy doc: https://intranet.redwood.com/fin/travel-policy```

Mei (Eng): Dietary/food allergies — where do we submit?

Deepti (People Ops): Fill this quick form for diet, room prefs, and accessibility needs: https://intranet.redwood.com/onsite/portland-form. If you need an ADA room or sensory-friendly space, check the box and we'll follow up privately.

travel-desk (Vendor): Flight suggestions posted in the doc (economy+flex). If you need bookings made for you, DM @travel-desk by May 10. Note: certain routes are Grayline-approved — we do not book premium unless pre-approved.

Sam (People Ops): Reminder: shared rooms are opt-in only. If you'd like to room-share to reduce cost, say so in the form and we'll match with same-gender/partner preferences.

Jonas (Eng): Any stipend for rideshare arrival if shuttle doesn't line up?

Carlos (Finance): If shuttle isn't feasible, submit rideshare under "onsite-transport" with receipts; approved up to $75 for airport transfers.

Mei (Eng): Accessibility detail: can you confirm quiet/sensory room availability? I need a low-sensory workspace for the afternoon sessions.

Deepti (People Ops): Yes — we booked a dedicated Quiet Room in the venue (Room E) with signage and a noise-dampening setup. We'll reserve slots; add your preferred time in the form. Contact me directly for further accommodations.

ops-bot: Calendar event created: "Q2 West Coast Retreat — Portland (Jun 14-16)" — https://calendar.redwood.com/event/1775001123

Ava (People Ops): RSVP deadline May 20 — if you miss it we may not be able to secure the hotel block. If you're remote-only but want to join dinners, mark "hybrid-dinner" on the form.

Deepti (People Ops): TL;DR — Dates Jun 14-16, hotel block at The Alder, shuttle Mon/Tue, travel subsidy details in finance doc, accessibility form link. DM if you need help booking. :sparkles:

Jonas (Eng): Thanks! Will fill the form and request a Quiet Room slot.

Ava (People Ops): Thanks all — I'll post a quick FAQ doc and travel checklist in #people-ops later today.
